title: SC Relegates GST Assessee to Appeal Remedy as Final Assessment Orders Were Already Passed
summary: The Supreme Court ruled that once final GST assessment orders are issued, taxpayers must use the statutory appellate remedy under Section 107 of the GST Act. Taxpayers cannot bypass this process and must raise any issues, including missing seized files, before the appellate authority.

title: Regulatory & Adjudicatory Functions Cannot Be Artificially Segregated for GST Levy: Gauhati HC
summary: The Gauhati High Court has determined that electricity regulatory functions and adjudicatory powers are integral parts of a single statutory framework. Therefore, they cannot be artificially split or classified as support services for the purpose of levying GST.

title: Karnataka HC Grants Protection From Coercive Action as Assessee Intended to File GST Appeal
summary: The Karnataka High Court provided relief to a taxpayer by restraining the tax department from taking any coercive recovery steps. This protection is granted on the condition that the petitioner files the statutory appeal against the GST adjudication order.

title: ITAT Deletes Addition Because Gratuity Payments Exceeded Interest Income
summary: The Kolkata ITAT has removed a tax addition against an employees' gratuity fund. The Tribunal noted that because the gratuity payouts were greater than the interest earned during the year, there was no net income to be taxed.

title: EPFO Claims Rejected in CIRP Due to Lack of Sections 7A, 7Q & 14B Adjudication
summary: The NCLT Mumbai approved a resolution plan, rejecting EPFO claims that were based only on provisional calculations without formal adjudication. The ruling asserts that only crystallized statutory liabilities determined through proper legal channels can be admitted during the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP).

title: Notification No. 38/2026: Revised ITR Forms for AY 2026-27 Now Available
summary: The CBDT has released updated ITR forms for Assessment Year 2026-27, incorporating the new tax slab rates from Budget 2026 and expanded reporting requirements. Key changes include a dedicated schedule for virtual digital assets, revised capital gains computation for new holding period rules, and updated Section 80C sub-limits.

title: Circular No. 09/2026: Clarification on Section 194T — TDS on Partnership Firm Payments
summary: The CBDT has issued Circular No. 09/2026, providing detailed clarifications on the newly introduced Section 194T regarding TDS on payments made by partnership firms to their partners. Effective from April 2026, firms must deduct TDS at 10% on salary, remuneration, commission, bonus, and interest payments exceeding Rs. 20,000 annually to each partner.

title: Advisory: New Annual Information Statement (AIS) 2.0 Portal Goes Live
summary: The Income Tax Department has launched AIS 2.0, a revamped portal providing taxpayers with a comprehensive 360-degree view of their financial transactions. The upgraded system now integrates data from mutual fund houses, stock brokers, banks, property registrars, and cryptocurrency exchanges in near real-time.

title: Instruction No. 05/2026: Revised Monetary Limits for Filing Appeals
summary: The CBDT has issued Instruction No. 05/2026, revising the monetary limits for filing departmental appeals before ITAT, High Courts, and the Supreme Court. The new thresholds have been increased to Rs. 60 lakh for ITAT, Rs. 2 crore for High Courts, and Rs. 5 crore for the Supreme Court.

title: Central Tax Notification 18/2026: Mandatory IMS Reconciliation Before GSTR-3B Filing
summary: The GSTN has made it mandatory for all registered taxpayers to reconcile their Input Tax Credit (ITC) through the Invoice Management System (IMS) before filing GSTR-3B, effective from June 2026 returns. The IMS dashboard now requires explicit acceptance or rejection of each inward supply invoice.

title: Circular No. 210/2026: Clarification on GST Applicability for EV Charging Stations
summary: The CBIC has issued Circular No. 210/2026, providing crucial clarifications on the GST treatment of electric vehicle (EV) charging services. The circular confirms that supply of electricity through charging stations is classified as a 'service' and not a 'sale of goods', attracting 18% GST under SAC 9987.

title: General Circular 08/2026: Extended Timeline for Filing MSME Form I (Half-Yearly Return)
summary: The MCA has extended the deadline for filing MSME Form I (Half-Yearly Return on outstanding payments to MSMEs) for the period October 2025 to March 2026. The new deadline provides a 30-day extension from the original due date.

title: Notification: Companies (Accounts) Amendment Rules, 2026 — Sustainability Reporting
summary: The MCA has notified the Companies (Accounts) Amendment Rules, 2026, introducing mandatory sustainability and ESG reporting for companies with a net worth exceeding Rs. 500 crore. The Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) framework has been updated to include Scope 3 emission disclosures.

title: Update: V3 Portal — Digital Verification Module for Director DIN-KYC Now Live
summary: The MCA V3 portal has launched a streamlined digital verification module for the annual Director DIN-KYC process. Directors can now complete their KYC entirely through Aadhaar-based e-KYC with facial recognition, eliminating the need for DSC-based filing in cases with no data changes.

title: Circular No. 06/2026: Revised Norms for Related Party Transactions Under Section 188
summary: MCA Circular No. 06/2026 introduces revised materiality thresholds and approval mechanisms for Related Party Transactions (RPTs) under Section 188 of the Companies Act. The new norms lower the threshold for mandatory audit committee review to Rs. 1 crore.
